verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an experimentation and feature-flag platform, for example scheduled rollouts or recurring reports, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no scheduling of any kind, one-off or recurring. Autotune's automatic variant weighting is an adjacent feature, not a schedule. The Console API and MCP server are developer building blocks a user could pair with an external scheduler, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
